claims.inscription: This memorial bench is dedicated to the enduring memory / of our beloved Elianne whose life was a tapestry of beauty, strength, and kindness. / In her 15 years, she embraced humility, faith, and compassion, leaving an indelible mark / on our hearts. / May those who rest here find solace in the enduring spirit of an amazing soul, / forever missed but never forgotten. / Elianne Andam / 28.06.2008 27.09.2023
